title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to the docs site and redwood-examples. Motivation: provide reproducible, production-oriented quickstarts that show how to wire RAG templates with tool calling (search, SQL, calendar) and how to deploy the agent with Redwood Private/Dedicated. This PR includes templates for retrieval-first agent patterns, canonical prompt wrappers, structured output examples, and 3 quickstarts (webapp demo, scheduled-agent with calendar integration, and SQL-backed knowledge base). Checklist: [x] add agent templates under redwood-examples/rag-templates; [x] add quickstart guides and code samples in redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/rag-agent; [x] update docs navigation and TOC; [x] add tests for example templates (smoke/CI); [x] add changelog/release notes. Testing: local smoke tests for examples, CI runs for docs build (Docusaurus) and redwood-examples unit tests. Related: ENG-4042, DOCS-178. See internal playbook link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4042/agent-rag-quickstarts. Merge notes: squash merge after CI green. No breaking API changes.
